req.title: Show index page
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET / with an HTML page listing all posts ordered by created descending.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the index page should list all posts in descending order of creation. Tests should cover the correct rendering of posts, handle errors gracefully, and ensure boundary conditions are respected.

tests.name: test_index_page_shows_posts
preconditions: Database is initialized with pre-loaded posts.
expected: HTML page with post titles in descending order of creation.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Initialize the database
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()

r = client.get('/')
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'Heacon signal pulse' in r.data  # Most recent post
assert b'Pulse ember signal' in r.data  # Oldest post

tests.name: test_index_page_client_error
preconditions: Database is initialized with pre-loaded posts.
actions: Send malformed GET request to '/' endpoint.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Initialize the database
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()

try:
    r = client.get('/nonexistent')
    assert r.status_code == 404
except Exception as e:
    assert False, f"Unexpected error: {e}"

tests.name: test_index_page_boundary_case
preconditions: Database is initialized with exactly one post.
expected: HTML page with exactly one post title.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Initialize the database with one post
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import get_db, init_db
    init_db()
    db = get_db()
    db.execute("DELETE FROM post")
    db.execute("INSERT INTO post (id, author_id, created, title, body) VALUES (21, 1, '2025-04-02 10:30:37', 'Boundary post', 'Boundary body')")
    db.commit()

r = client.get('/')
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'Boundary post' in r.data
